data.summary: Payments v2.4 enabled strict_currency_validation, which rejects legacy currency strings sent by checkout, causing 503 errors across payments, checkout, and storefront. The compatibility advisory explicitly allows rollback of payments to v2.3 under schema 1 while disallowing flag-only mitigation. Therefore, rollback of deployment on payments is proposed.
